overview: The Medford School Committee received administrative reports covering substance use grants, childhood obesity initiatives, social-emotional learning, professional development, and open house events. The committee also honored Medford Family Network Director Marie Cassidy and referred a resolution on weekend community meetings to a subcommittee.

items.title: Project HAIR Grant Report
items.summary: The committee accepted a report on a $13,387 substance use prevention grant used to train middle school staff in the Michigan Model curriculum.

items.title: Childhood Obesity Prevention Program Report
items.summary: The committee accepted a report detailing a $2,000 grant from Hallmark Health to provide personal pedometers for fourth-grade students.

items.title: Social Emotional Learning Report
items.summary: Staff presented an update on district social-emotional learning initiatives, including parent support groups, staff training, and suicide prevention programs.

items.title: Report on Professional Development Day
items.summary: Dr. Bernadette Ricciardelli presented survey results showing strong staff satisfaction across 28 workshops held during the November 6 professional development day.

items.title: ABCD Community Hero Award Recognition
items.summary: The committee recognized Medford Family Network Director Marie Cassidy for receiving the 2018 ABCD Community Hero Award.

items.title: Grade 8 Open House Report
items.summary: High school administrators reported on the October 18 Grade 8 Open House, which featured student-led tours and technical program demonstrations.

items.title: Veterans Day Program Report
items.summary: The committee accepted a report on the 18th annual Veterans Day speaker program, which brought 13 veterans into 46 high school classrooms.

items.title: Resolution on Weekend Community Participation Meetings
items.summary: A proposal to hold two Saturday afternoon community meetings per year with childcare was referred to the Community Engagement Subcommittee.

items.title: Condolences and Status of Requested Reports
items.summary: The committee observed a moment of silence for deceased former staff and family members and briefly reviewed pending administrative reports.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee voted to enter executive session to discuss strategy regarding negotiations and legal matters.
